# x402-json-patch-rfc6902

RFC 6902 JSON Patch apply microservice.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/json-patch — paid

## Pricing
~0.004–0.010 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "document": {...}, "patch": [ { "op": "...", "path": "...", ... } ] }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
